d: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?
